subject: Private deployment architecture review — final-hop networking & air-gap constraints
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: infra@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - architecture review request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our security team would like a technical deep-dive focused on the 'final hop' network architecture and practical constraints for an air-gapped install — specifically:
- Allowed egress patterns from the private cluster (if any)
- Certificate & NTP provisioning during install
- Updates/patching strategy for models and runtime in an air-gapped environment
- How Redwood recommends validating KV cache persistence for short outages

We'd like a ~60–75 minute session with our infra lead (Ben Ortiz) and security lead (Aisha Park). Are you available next Tuesday or Thursday morning PST?

Attached is our internal pre-checklist — flags we commonly require.

Thanks,
Daniel
Infra Operations | Acme Health

[Attachment: acme_airgap_preflight_checklist.pdf]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - architecture review request

Daniel — thanks for the detail, this is exactly the right set of topics. We can do a focused walkthrough and come with concrete ops-level mitigations for each item. Proposed approach:
1) 15m: alignment on constraints & acceptable maintenance windows
2) 30m: network and install flow (certs, NTP, package bundles, air-gap tooling)
3) 20m: runbook validation and Q&A (KV cache, patching cadence, rollbacks)

Availability: Thu 2027-04-08 09:30–10:45 PT or Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–11:15 PT. Please confirm attendees and which slot suits you. I'll include the architecture diagram and a short annotated checklist.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0132

[Will attach: final-hop-vpc-diagram-annotated.png]

From: Ben Ortiz <infra@acmehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T07:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - architecture review request

Priya — quick note from our side: we have a maintenance blackout 2027-04-07 through 2027-04-09 for patient-facing systems, so Thu morning is difficult for Ben/Ops. We can do Tue 10:00 PT but need the session to finish before 11:30 PT.

Also, small ask: can you confirm whether Redwood's air-gap updater supports unsigned bundles (we will sign internally) and whether we can stage a local mirror for model artifacts?

Thanks,
Ben
Infrastructure Lead | Acme Health

--- Forwarded attachment: acme_airgap_preflight_checklist.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - architecture review request

Ben / Daniel — thanks for the heads up. Confirming internal attendees and owners for the session:
- Diego Fernandez (runtime & installer flow)
- Evelyn Hart (security & KMS/HSM integration)
- Soojin Lee (networking & final-hop NAT/proxy patterns)

Short answers now:
- We support staged local mirrors for model artifacts (we'll bring a sample mirror-sync plan).
- Our updater can be configured to validate signatures from a customer CA; we can walk the signing flow in the session.

We'll reserve Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–11:15 PT and prepare the annotated diagram and a short runbook draft. Priya will share the calendar invite and attachments.

Diego
Principal Engineer, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: final-hop-vpc-diagram-annotated.png]

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Ben Ortiz <infra@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - architecture review request

Thanks — Tue 04/06 10:00 PT works for Ben and I. Couple of additional asks for the agenda:
- Please include a short slide showing file transfer options (sneakernet, scp over bastion, physical media import) and any checksum/hashing recommendations we should follow.
- Can you note any blocked ports and minimal egress IP ranges if ephemeral outbound is needed for telemetry backfill?

We'll be tight on time so appreciate keeping demos minimal and runbook-focused.

—Daniel
